name: 84088 · West Jordan, UT
findings: ZIP 84088 (West Jordan) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84088 (West Jordan) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
